name: wayfinder
description: Multi-session exploration and decision-mapping for projects whose scope exceeds a single brainstorming session. Opens a wayfinder map, drives resolution across sessions via prototype/research/decision tickets (NO generic 'task' type) arranged as a ticket DAG with blockedBy edges, and on close generates Phase 0 of .omo/plans/<slug>.md then archives to .omo/wayfinder-archive/. Use when the user says 'wayfinder', 'decision mapping', 'multi-session planning', or when scope clearly spans multiple sessions with tickets blocking each other. NOT for single-session scope (use brainstorming), hotfixes / one-file changes (no design phase), known-shape work (go straight to spec-driven-development), or pure debugging (use debugging-and-error-recovery).

positive_triggers.reason: Explicit slash command trigger — opens a new multi-session decision-mapping session.

negative_triggers.reason: Hotfix / single-file change → skip design phase entirely; no wayfinder / no brainstorming.
Known-shape implementation work → spec-driven-development / incremental-implementation, not wayfinder.

behavioral_evals.scenario: User has 3 tickets — ticket 01 blockedBy 02, ticket 02 blockedBy 01 (cycle). They run scripts/wayfinder-close.sh.
expected_behavior: Script reads all ticket YAML frontmatter
Script runs DFS / Tarjan cycle detection and finds the 01↔02 cycle
User must refactor the blockedBy edges (e.g. drop one of the edges or split a ticket) before re-running close

behavioral_evals.scenario: User has a single-session scope and tries to use wayfinder for it.
expected_behavior: Agent detects single-session scope (one decision's worth, no blockedBy edges, no research prototype decisions mixed in)
Agent does NOT open .omo/wayfinder/<slug>/ — instead routes to brainstorming
If user explicitly insists on /wayfinder, agent opens scaffold but flags the mismatch in the [wayfinder] log so the next session can decide

behavioral_evals.scenario: User tries to add a ticket with type='task' to escape the 3-type taxonomy.
expected_behavior: Agent explains: only prototype / research / decision are allowed; if the work is not classifiable, it is not ticket-shaped yet (defer to a follow-up wayfinder session)
Agent does not write the ticket file

behavioral_evals.scenario: User closes a wayfinder with all tickets resolved; then re-runs scripts/wayfinder-close.sh <slug>.
expected_behavior: First close: validates types + DAG + status, generates .omo/plans/<slug>.md, moves .omo/wayfinder/<slug>/ to .omo/wayfinder-archive/<slug>/, appends [wayfinder] entry to .omo/notepads/<slug>/decisions.md, exits 0
Second close: detects existing archive directory, prints 'already closed', exits 0 without re-generating plan.md or double-appending to decisions.md

notes: Lifecycle is owned by scripts/wayfinder-{init,close}.sh (deterministic, tested via scripts/test-wayfinder-lifecycle.sh covering T1 init tree+schema, T2 invalid slug refused, T3 idempotent init, T4 3 valid types accepted, T5 task type refused, T6 cycle refused, T7 unresolved refused, T8 archive + plan generated, T9 idempotent close).
